label: pinMode
info: Configures a pin as INPUT, OUTPUT or INPUT_PULLUP.

label: digitalWrite
info: Sets a digital output pin to HIGH or LOW.

label: digitalRead
info: Reads a digital pin. Returns HIGH or LOW.

label: analogRead
info: Reads an analog pin. 0–1023 on Uno, 0–4095 on ESP32.

label: analogWrite
info: Writes a PWM value to a pin. Used to dim LEDs or control motor speed.

label: delay
info: Pauses the program for the given number of milliseconds.

label: delayMicroseconds
info: Pauses the program for the given number of microseconds.

label: millis
info: Milliseconds since the board started running. Use it for timing without blocking.

label: micros
info: Microseconds since the board started running.

label: map
info: Re-maps a number from one range to another.

label: constrain
info: Limits a number to the range min..max.

label: random
info: Returns a pseudo-random number. The max value is excluded.

label: randomSeed
info: Initializes the random number generator.

label: min
info: Returns the smaller of two numbers.

label: max
info: Returns the larger of two numbers.

label: abs
info: Returns the absolute value of a number.

label: pow
info: Raises a number to a power.

label: sqrt
info: Returns the square root of a number.

label: attachInterrupt
info: Runs a function when a pin changes. Mode: RISING, FALLING or CHANGE.

label: detachInterrupt
info: Turns off an interrupt on a pin.

label: Serial.begin
info: Starts serial communication. 115200 is common for ESP32.

label: Serial.print
info: Prints data to the serial monitor without a newline.

label: Serial.println
info: Prints data to the serial monitor followed by a newline.

label: Serial.printf
info: Prints formatted text, like printf in C.

label: Serial.available
info: Number of bytes waiting to be read from the serial port.

label: Serial.read
info: Reads one byte from the serial port. Returns -1 if nothing is available.

label: Serial.readString
info: Reads characters from the serial port into a String.

label: Serial.write
info: Writes raw bytes to the serial port.

label: HIGH
info: Logic high level, usually 3.3 V or 5 V.

label: LOW
info: Logic low level, 0 V.

label: INPUT
info: Pin works as an input.

label: OUTPUT
info: Pin works as an output.

label: INPUT_PULLUP
info: Input with the internal pull-up resistor enabled.

label: LED_BUILTIN
info: Pin number of the on-board LED.

label: RISING
info: Interrupt triggers when the pin goes from LOW to HIGH.

label: FALLING
info: Interrupt triggers when the pin goes from HIGH to LOW.

label: CHANGE
info: Interrupt triggers when the pin changes its value.

label: String
info: Arduino text type. Supports +, length(), substring() and more.

label: byte
info: Unsigned 8-bit number.

label: Wire.begin
info: Starts the I2C bus.

label: Wire.beginTransmission
info: Starts sending data to an I2C device.

label: Wire.write
info: Queues a byte for sending over I2C.

label: Wire.endTransmission
info: Sends the queued bytes. Returns 0 on success.

label: Wire.requestFrom
info: Asks an I2C device for bytes.

label: Wire.read
info: Reads one byte received over I2C.

label: WiFi.begin
info: Connects to a Wi-Fi network.

label: WiFi.status
info: Returns the connection status. WL_CONNECTED means connected.

label: WiFi.localIP
info: IP address of the board on the network.

label: WiFi.disconnect
info: Disconnects from the Wi-Fi network.

label: WiFi.mode
info: Sets Wi-Fi mode: WIFI_STA, WIFI_AP or WIFI_AP_STA.

label: WL_CONNECTED
info: Value returned by WiFi.status() when connected.

label: ESP.restart
info: Restarts the board.

label: ESP.getFreeHeap
info: Free heap memory in bytes.
